name: reconnect
description: Continues a session that stopped because the network went away, or on an error worth another go, once the network is back, backing off between tries. Never after a usage limit or a login problem. An example of the UI hooks: rush's own retry does this already.

settings.title: Wait before continuing
settings.description: After a retryable error, and the backoff's first step: each try waits twice as long as the one before.

settings.title: Tries before giving up
settings.description: How many times it sends continue before it stops and tells you.

settings.title: Retry what rush retries
settings.description: rush continues its own sessions, and others for a day, after these errors. Off leaves those to rush, so a session isn't told to continue twice.
